Title: Add retry+circuit breaker resilience pipeline to Worker node HttpClients in Dashboard
Description: In SplitBrain.Dashboard/Program.cs, Ollama nodes get retry + circuit breaker + per-node timeout via AddResilienceHandler. Worker nodes only get AddHttpClient with a doubled Timeout and no retry or circuit breaking. A slow or flaky Worker (e.g. during model load on GTX 1080) will hang or fail without retry. Fix: add the same resilience handler pattern used for Ollama to Worker node clients.
